widgets_values: Industrial rock, hammering machine percussion with metallic clangs, distorted bass, cold analog synth, shouted male lead with a gang chorus, gritty lo-fi production, relentless and mechanical

[Verse]
Steel is breathing in the dark
Pistons counting out the hour
Every window blind with sparks
Every hand a kind of power
Hammers fall like steady rain
On the anvil of the day
We are forging something nameless
From the rust and from the clay

[Chorus]
Iron heart, iron heart
Turn the wheel and hold the line
Iron heart, iron heart
Everything we build is mine

[Verse]
Furnace glow along the floor
Shadows walk the factory wall
We have heard the engines roar
And we never once will fall
Oil and smoke and borrowed light
Every rivet set in time
We will work into the night
Till the morning bells will chime

[Chorus]
Iron heart, iron heart
Turn the wheel and hold the line
Iron heart, iron heart
Everything we build is mine

[Bridge]
And when the metal sings
And when the silence breaks
We will know the shape of things
By everything it makes

[Final Chorus]
Iron heart, iron heart
Turn the wheel and hold the line
Iron heart, iron heart
Everything we build is mine

[Outro]
Turn the wheel, turn the wheel
Hold the line

## ACE-Step latent repaint (E19) - regenerate a time span, keep the rest

**The masked-latent route, and it works.** ACE-Step core (MIT) encodes the take, masks a band of the
audio latent, and re-samples **only that band** - the rest of the take comes back at the VAE round-trip
level, i.e. untouched. **15.4 s per 120 s take.**

- **the span** is typed as **`repair from (s)` / `repair to (s)`** - two `FloatConstant`s. Three
  `ComfyMathExpression` nodes turn them into the latent frames the mask works in (**25 per second**):
  `from` x25 -> `MaskComposite.x`, `(to-from)` x25 -> the ones-mask `width`, and the clip length x25 ->
  the zeros-mask `width` (so `clip length (s)` must be the take's own length). Repairing 55-61 s of a
  120 s take is just `55` and `61` - no arithmetic, and the span is `[from, to)`.
- **`tags` + `lyrics` are the take's whole prompt** - the same deal as an image inpaint, where the
  prompt describes the whole picture and the mask picks the region. The mask confines *where* the
  sampling changes; the text says what the piece is. Give it the take's own style and its full lyric
  (E19b; trimming the lyric to just the span's words is untested).
- **`SetAudioLatentNoiseMask`** - a **10-line custom node** (`custom_nodes/audio_latent_mask/`, mirrored
  to `audio/custom_nodes/`), and the flow **does not run without it**. The core `SetLatentNoiseMask`
  reshapes every mask to 4-D, which is right for image latents and wrong for a 3-D audio latent: its
  `reshape_mask` path then wants a 3-D mask and raises *"input with spatial dimensions of [1, 3000]"*.
  This node stores the mask unchanged. Drop-in, same inputs/output.
- **`denoise` 1.0** on `KSampler` is right here: the noise mask already confines the sampling, so 1.0
  means "regenerate the band", not "regenerate everything".

**What E19 measured (control = the same flow with an all-zero mask, i.e. the VAE round-trip alone):**

| | `mean|diff|` outside 55-61 s | inside |
|---|---|---|
| repaint vs round-trip | **0.0015** | **0.198** (127.7x) |
| original vs round-trip | 0.02061 | - |
| original vs repaint | 0.02077 | - |

The last two agree to four decimals: **the surrounding audio is preserved exactly** and the only outside
difference is the encode/decode round-trip. Refilling a *deleted* span works too - it returns at
**-14.77 dB** against the original's -13.07 dB.

**Two things to know before trusting a repaint.** (1) It is a **different performance** of that span
(E18c), so the join is still a listening question - this route proves the *surroundings* are untouched,
which is what every other route failed. (2) The mask edges are **hard** - the `GrowMaskWithBlur` on the band is a no-op at
`expand` 0 / `blur_radius` 0.0, so raise it only if a click at the span's ends shows up.


**Dead ends this replaces:** the kaola pack's `ACE_STEP_Repaint` (`scratch/ace-step-repaint.json`,
kept for the record) and the `ReplaceVideoLatentFrames` comp (E18b) both rewrote the whole take
(outside `mean|diff|` ~0.06-0.075, flat).

---
*How to run it: story **S24** in `HOWTO.md`  ·  Why it is this way: **E19/E19b** in `audio/EXPERIMENTS.md`.*
